entries.displayName: Neuronto ARD Registry: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) registry
entries.description: A federated ARD registry and index. Implements federation: auto with reciprocal rank fusion across every other public ARD registry, normalises the competing MCP media types and URN prefixes so filters do not silently miss, and probes endpoints so dead resources are demoted rather than served.
